A connection on the tangent bundle, described in the actual adapted
charts. The overlap equation is the standard affine transformation of a

{E : Type u_1} →

      [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
        [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] →
          [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] →
            {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} →
              [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] →
                [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] →
                  [inst_5 : IsManifold I 1 M] →
                    {n : WithTop ℕ∞} →
                      [inst_6 : IsManifold I (n + 1) M] →
                        {Q :
                            QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldQuaternionicMetric.SmoothQuaternionicHermitianTangent} →
                          (form :
                              M →
                                QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldQuaternionicConnection.ConnectionForm) →
                            (∀ (p : M), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (form p) (extChartAt I p).target) →
                              (∀ (p q : M),
                                  ∀
                                    y ∈
                                      QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldQuaternionicConnection.chartOverlap
                                        p q,
                                    form p y =
                                      QuaternionicSymmetry.LocalConnectionGauge.transform
                                        (QuaternionicSymmetry.LocalConnectionCoordinatePullback.pullback
                                          (form q)
                                          (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldQuaternionicConnection.chartTransition
                                            p q))
                                        (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldQuaternionicConnection.adaptedGauge
                                          Q p q)

                          Q} →
                      {n : ℕ} →
                        (charts :
                            ChartedSpace
                              (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                n)
                              (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorSphereCore.SphereBundleTotal
                                Q)) →
                          IsManifold
                              (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ
                                (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                  n))
                              (↑⊤)
                              (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorSphereCore.SphereBundleTotal Q) →
                            IsManifold
                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                  (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                    n))
                                (↑⊤)
                                (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorSphereCore.SphereBundleTotal
                                  Q) →
                              ContMDiff
                                  (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                    (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                      n))
                                  QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.RealModel✝
                                  (↑⊤) id →
                                ContMDiff
                                    QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.RealModel✝¹
                                    (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                      (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                        n))
                                    (↑⊤) id →
                                  (∀
                                      (z :
                                        QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorSphereCore.SphereBundleTotal
                                          Q)
                                      (v :
                                        TangentSpace

                                            QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.RealModel✝²

                                                (QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.ComplexTwistorModel
                                                  n))
                                              QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.RealModel✝³
                                              id z)
                                            v)) →
                                    QuaternionicSymmetry.ManifoldTwistorLeBrunComplexAtlas.CompatibleComplexAtlas

                              (↑⊤) Z) →
                          IsManifold
                              (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝² n))
                              (↑⊤) Z →
                            ContMDiff
                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                  (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝³ n))
                                IR (↑⊤) id →
                              ContMDiff IR
                                  (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                    (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝⁴ n))
                                  (↑⊤) id →
                                (Index : Type) →
                                  (line : VectorBundleCore ℂ Z ℂ Index) →
                                    line.IsContMDiff
                                        (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ
                                          (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝⁵ n))
                                        ↑⊤ →
                                      (theta : (z : Z) → TangentSpace IR z →ₗ[ℝ] line.Fiber z) →
                                        (∀ (z : Z), Function.Surjective ⇑(theta z)) →
                                          (ContMDiff
                                              (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ
                                                  (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝⁶
                                                    n)).tangent
                                              ((modelWithCornersSelf ℂ
                                                    (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝⁷
                                                      n)).prod
                                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ))
                                              ↑⊤ fun t =>
                                              { proj := t.proj,
                                                snd :=
                                                  (theta t.proj)
                                                    ((mfderiv
                                                        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ
                                                          (QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.V✝⁸
                                                            n))
                                                        IR id t.proj)
                                                      t.snd) }) →
                                            (∀ (z : Z) (u : ↥(theta z).ker),
                                                u ≠ 0 →
                                                  ∃ U,
                                                    IsOpen U ∧
                                                      z ∈ U ∧
                                                        ∃ X Y,
                                                          ContMDiffOn IR IR.tangent (↑⊤)
                                                              (fun y => { proj := y, snd := X y })
                                                              U ∧
                                                            ContMDiffOn IR IR.tangent (↑⊤)
                                                                (fun y => { proj := y, snd := Y y })
                                                                U ∧
                                                              (∀ y ∈ U, X y ∈ (theta y).ker) ∧
                                                                (∀ y ∈ U, Y y ∈ (theta y).ker) ∧
                                                                  X z = ↑u ∧
                                                                    (theta z)
                                                                        (VectorField.mlieBracket IR
                                                                          X Y z) ≠
                                                                      0) →
                                              QuaternionicSymmetry.GeneralComplexContactData.ContactGeometry
                                                n
